verses.1: He that feareth the Lord will do this; And he that hath possession of the law shall obtain her.
verses.2: And as a mother shall she meet him, And receive him as a wife married in her virginity.
verses.3: With bread of understanding shall she feed him, And give him water of wisdom to drink.
verses.4: He shall be stayed upon her, and shall not be moved; And shall rely upon her, and shall not be confounded.
verses.5: And she shall exalt him above his neighbours; And in the midst of the congregation shall she open his mouth.
verses.6: He shall inherit joy, and a crown of gladness, And an everlasting name.
verses.7: Foolish men shall not obtain her; And sinners shall not see her.
verses.8: She is far from pride; And liars shall not remember her.
verses.9: Praise is not comely in the mouth of a sinner; For it was not sent him from the Lord.
verses.10: For praise shall be spoken in wisdom; And the Lord will prosper it.
verses.11: Say not thou, It is through the Lord that I fell away; For thou shalt not do the things that he hateth.
verses.12: Say not thou, It is he that caused me to err; For he hath no need of a sinful man.
verses.13: The Lord hateth every abomination; And they that fear him love it not.
verses.14: He himself made man from the beginning, And left him in the hand of his own counsel.
verses.15: If thou wilt, thou shalt keep the commandments; And to perform faithfulness is of thine own good pleasure.
verses.16: He hath set fire and water before thee: Thou shalt stretch forth thy hand unto whichsoever thou wilt.
verses.17: Before man is life and death; And whichsoever he liketh, it shall be given him.
verses.18: For great is the wisdom of the Lord: He is mighty in power, and beholdeth all things;
verses.19: And his eyes are upon them that fear him; And he will take knowledge of every work of man.
verses.20: He hath not commanded any man to be ungodly; And he hath not given any man licence to sin.
